name: Hardcore setting starts with half cohesion and nine unchanged rivals
Changing next-journey difficulty does not weaken the current run
Evolution healing and idle regeneration cannot exceed half cohesion
All four route evolutions retain Hardcore cohesion
Saved difficulty and damaged cohesion survive reload after changing future settings
Older or edited Hardcore checkpoints above 50 restore safely at the cap
Sandbox class switches and final-merger healing respect Hardcore limit
Hardcore HUD shows the cap, mode and absolute 50-percent cohesion
World rarity decreases across planetary, stellar and black-hole stages
Route-aware peer threshold uses selected-path mass rather than visual class index
Twenty Hardcore restarts add no listeners, loops or accumulated simulation objects
Copyright is present in launch menu, credits, support pages and license without removing MIT notice
Natural rare worlds carry caches while ordinary rocks and other modes do not
Rare body and stored disk cache survive save/load, then credit exactly once
Full body pool transfers cache into saved drone cargo and delivers without duplication
Standard cannot collect bonus Research Points and malformed payloads are rejected
Recycled bodies cannot retain a previously claimed rare cache
